1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said diodes are mounted on said body using a substrate material different from the material of said columnar body.

2. (Original)

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, wherein said optic element is configured to provide wavelength conversion and light scattering characteristics.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material configured to convert at least a portion of light emitted by said diodes into a different wavelength.

5. (Original)

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes and are configured to provide thermal dissipation while maintaining light transmittable surface area.

7. (Original)

8. (Original)

9. (Original)

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face, and wherein said single diode on each face is positioned at a center location of said face.

11. (Original)

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, wherein each optic element is individually configured to direct light from its corresponding diode.

13. (Original)

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current and further including a current limiting circuit.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body and is configured to provide a beam angle of at least 120 degrees.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body using a thermally conductive substrate, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, and wherein said diodes are mounted on said sides using a mounting substrate material.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body using a thermally conductive substrate material, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Original)

19. (Original)

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls and wherein said body is extruded with integral radially extending fins formed during the extrusion process.
